# Rift Discord Engine (v0.2.0)

> The zero-unsafe, sans-I/O Discord v10 architecture built in Rust with native bindings for Node.js, Bun, and Python (v0.2.0).

## Core Concepts
- Pure Sans-I/O: Protocol state machines are decoupled from network transports, allowing deterministic testing and zero-overhead execution.
- Zero Unsafe: Every crate in the workspace compiles under `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`.
- 100% OpenAPI 3.1 Spec Coverage: 250/250 Discord REST routes implemented, typed, and continuously validated against Discord's official schema.
- True Multi-Language: Write in Rust (`use rift::prelude::*;`), Node.js/Bun (`import { RiftClient, Intents } from 'rift-discord'`), or Python (`from rift import RiftClient, Intents`).

## Installation
- Rust (Cargo): `cargo add rift-discord`
- Node.js (npm): `npm install rift-discord`
- Bun: `bun add rift-discord`
- Python (pip): `pip install rift-discord`

## Developer Guides & Handbook (8 Chapters)
1. Getting Started & First Bot (Discord Developer Portal, Bot Token, Privileged Intents)
2. Slash Commands & Interaction Routing (Public vs Ephemeral, Async Deferrals, Autocomplete)
3. Interactive Buttons, Select Menus & Modals (Action Rows, Form Submissions)
4. Gateway Runtime, Sharding & Resiliency (Zstd-stream, Supervisor, Backpressure)
5. State Cache & Nov 16 Obfuscation Safety (Permission Engine, Ring Buffers)
6. 250/250 REST Operations & Webhook Signatures (Rate Limits, Ed25519 Verifier)
7. Voice Gateway v8 & DAVE MLS Audio (UDP Discovery, RTP Framing, XChaCha20-Poly1305)
8. AI Agent Integration (Cursor, Claude, Antigravity with Rift MCP)
